verses.text: Moses gathered the whole community of Israel together and said to them, "These are the things the LORD has commanded you to do.
For six days work may be done, but the seventh day is to be your holy day, a Sabbath of complete rest to the LORD. Anyone who does any work on that day must be put to death.
Do not light a fire in any of your homes on the Sabbath day."
Moses said to the whole community of Israel, "This is what the LORD has commanded:
From what you have, bring an offering to the LORD. Everyone who is willing is to bring the LORD an offering of gold, silver, and bronze;
blue, purple, and red yarn; fine linen; goat hair;
ram skins dyed red; fine leather; acacia wood;
olive oil for the lamps; spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet-smelling incense;
and onyx stones and other jewels to be set in the ephod and the chest piece.
All the skilled workers among you are to come and make everything the LORD has commanded:
the holy tent with its tent and its covering, its hooks, frames, crossbars, posts, and bases;
the ark with its poles, its cover, and the curtain that hides it;
the table with its poles and all its tools, and the special bread;
the lampstand for light with its tools and lamps, and oil for the light;
the altar of incense with its poles, the anointing oil and the sweet-smelling incense, and the screen for the entrance of the holy tent;
the altar of burnt offering with its bronze grate, its poles and all its tools, and the washing bowl with its stand;
the curtains of the courtyard with their posts and bases, and the screen for the entrance to the courtyard;
the tent pegs for the holy tent and for the courtyard, and their ropes;
and the woven clothes for serving in the Holy Place, both the holy clothes for Aaron the priest and the clothes for his sons when they serve as priests."
Then the whole community of Israel left Moses.
Everyone whose heart moved him and whose spirit made him willing came and brought an offering to the LORD for the work on the Tent of Meeting, for all its service, and for the holy clothes.
All who were willing, both men and women, came and brought gold jewellery of every kind: pins, earrings, rings, and necklaces. Everyone brought their gold as a wave offering to the LORD.
Everyone who had blue, purple, or red yarn, or fine linen, or goat hair, or ram skins dyed red, or fine leather, brought them.
Everyone who could give silver or bronze brought it as an offering to the LORD. And everyone who had acacia wood for any part of the work brought it.
Every skilled woman spun yarn with her hands and brought what she had spun: blue, purple, and red yarn, and fine linen.
And all the women who were willing and had the skill spun the goat hair.
The leaders brought onyx stones and other jewels to be set in the ephod and the chest piece.
They also brought spices and olive oil for the light, for the anointing oil, and for the sweet-smelling incense.
All the men and women of Israel who were willing brought to the LORD a gift they freely chose to give, for all the work the LORD had commanded through Moses.
Then Moses said to the people of Israel, "Look, the LORD has chosen Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, from the tribe of Judah.
He has filled him with the Spirit of God, with wisdom, understanding, and knowledge, and with skill in all kinds of work.
He can make beautiful designs and work with gold, silver, and bronze,
cut and set precious stones, carve wood, and do every kind of skilled work.
And the LORD has given both him and Oholiab son of Ahisamach, from the tribe of Dan, the ability to teach others.

He has filled them with skill to do every kind of work as carvers, designers, and people who sew beautiful patterns in blue, purple, and red yarn and fine linen, and as weavers. They can do every kind of work and make beautiful designs.
